name: scenario_0090
description: Nancy is working on a political analysis project, tracking various international political parties and demographics. She is organizing her watchlist and sharing key data insights with her friend Alex.

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1
Query: Create a new note called 'Election Watchlist' and add these political parties to it: AKP, CHP, BJP, AAP, Lib Dems, Green, and UKIP.
Instructions: Instruct the assistant to create a new note titled 'Election Watchlist' containing the specified list of political parties. Once the assistant confirms the note has been created successfully, proceed to the next round.

ROUND 2 [provide: image_1, image_2, image_3]
Query: Filter the political parties in my 'Election Watchlist' note. For any party in the list that achieved over 45% of the vote in the most recent election shown in their respective chart, send a separate text message to Alex saying '[Party] reached [Percentage]% in the latest results'.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to analyze the three provided election charts to identify which parties from your note scored over 45% in their most recent election, and to text the results to Alex. Because there are multiple people named Alex in your contacts, the assistant should ask for clarification. When it does, specify that you mean Alexander Riddle. If the assistant misreads the most recent data points, direct it to look at the far right of the line graphs or the single data set in the semi-circle chart. Move on once the messages are sent.

ROUND 3 [provide: image_4]
Query: Look at this political poster. The text box mentions two parties that want this 'US style' system. Check my 'Election Watchlist' note, and if either of those parties are currently in it, update the note to remove them.
Instructions: Direct the assistant to read the central text box in the provided political poster, identify the two political parties mentioned as wanting the 'US style' system, and remove them from your 'Election Watchlist' note if they are present. Once the assistant confirms the note has been updated, proceed to the next round.

ROUND 4 [provide: image_5]
Query: Filter the demographic groups that have their percentage deviation explicitly labeled on this chart. For any group with a positive deviation of +3.5% or more from the average, send a text message to Alex saying 'We need to analyze the [Group] demographic'.
Instructions: Instruct the assistant to look at the provided bar chart and find the demographic groups that have explicit percentage deviation labels above or below their bars. Ask it to text Alex about any group with a positive deviation of +3.5% or more. If it asks to clarify which Alex again, confirm it's Alexander Riddle. Conclude the conversation once the messages are sent.

You have 5 images available to share with the agent using the send_message_with_image tool.
IMPORTANT: Image IDs are ZERO-INDEXED integers (0, 1, 2, ...). Do NOT add 1 to the IDs.
Available image IDs: [0, 1, 2, 3, 4]
Image mapping:
  image_1.jpg -> image ID 0
  image_2.jpg -> image ID 1
  image_3.jpg -> image ID 2
  image_4.jpg -> image ID 3
  image_5.jpg -> image ID 4

## IMAGE DELIVERY

⚠️ IMPORTANT: You MUST use the `send_message_with_image` tool to share images with User B. Do NOT just describe images in text — you MUST call the tool.

Image delivery schedule:

  Round 2: YOU MUST call the send_message_with_image tool with image_ids='0,1,2' — do NOT write the tool name as text; use the actual function call. Include a natural, conversational message to the assistant.
  Round 3: YOU MUST call the send_message_with_image tool with image_ids='3' — do NOT write the tool name as text; use the actual function call. Include a natural, conversational message to the assistant.
  Round 4: YOU MUST call the send_message_with_image tool with image_ids='4' — do NOT write the tool name as text; use the actual function call. Include a natural, conversational message to the assistant.
